scope: 0.1.5 pre-release hardening: cross-session replay, pairing-card checksum, document drift
review_issues_addressed: proof1 plan still required 0.1.4 and listed P-256 binding as future work
sync_protocol_design 12 and decision A2 still claimed code-based pairings carry no P-256 fingerprint
pairing card checksum did not cover the address field
signed payloads were not bound to a session, had no timestamp, and the replay cache lived only in memory

replay_fix.format: TWX3 | spki | nonce[32] | ts(u64) | challenge[32] | ack[32] | sig | body
replay_fix.signed: domain | sender fp | receiver fp | nonce | ts | challenge | ack | SHA-256(body)
replay_fix.timestamp: rejected when older than 120 s or more than 60 s in the future
replay_fix.challenge_chain: a request must echo the challenge the responder issued last; the responder issues a fresh one in every response
replay_fix.ack: a response echoes the request nonce, so an old response cannot answer a different request
replay_fix.persistence: schema 19 table sync_binding stores expected_challenge and next_challenge per paired device; a new pairing resets it
replay_fix.replay_window: a captured payload stops being valid after two minutes; within the window the nonce cache and the challenge chain still reject it

card_fix.checksum: first 8 hex of SHA-256 over a length-prefixed, domain-separated encoding of fingerprint, peerId and address
card_fix.explicit_note: the checksum is a copy/typo check, not authentication; anyone can rebuild a card and recompute it, so the fingerprint is only trustworthy if the card came through a channel the user controls

verification.host_tests: 95 pass; test_transport_binding covers bootstrap, challenge chaining, challenge mismatch, ack mismatch, fingerprint mismatch, tampered body, stale timestamp, future timestamp, nonce replay, legacy payload, truncated envelope; test_pairing_card covers address tampering and address injection
verification.device: 0.1.5 installed; schema 18 -> 19 migrated; audit page reports 10 events chain intact; RUN_SUITE 48 / TASK_CENTER 10 / RUN_DOCUMENTS 20 PASS
verification.not_verified: no two-device exchange, so the challenge chain has not been exercised across two real peers; no independent replay attempt on hardware
